Bring your expertise, enthusiasm, and commitment to excellence, and we’ll provide the tools and support to help you succeed.
STILL are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, abilities, and experience. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application or interview process to ensure fairness and accessibility, please let us know. Ready to join us? Apply today and take your career to the next level!

Kitman Labs is the performance intelligence company, disrupting and transforming the way the sports industry uses data to unlock the potential of the world's top athletes.
Driven by a passion to innovate in the areas of sports performance, analytics and user experience, we have assembled a team of the industry's top data scientists, sports performance scientists, product specialists and engineers.
Kitman Labs' advanced Intelligence Platform (iP) is now used by over 2000 teams in 50 leagues on 6 continents, including the NFL, Premier League, National Women's Soccer League and MLS.
The Role
As Salesforce Platform Owner, you will own Salesforce end to end for our Revenue Operations and Marketing teams. You will be the person who keeps the platform running well day to day and the person who decides how it should evolve. You will report to our Chief Marketing Officer and work closely with our Marketing Operations Manager and revenue leaders partnering with them frequently on campaigns, reporting, and the systems, data and processes that power our go-to-market.
That means gathering requirements, designing scalable solutions, setting the architecture and managing the product roadmap. It also means hands-on administration: configuration, reporting, end-user training, integrations, security and data integrity. You will work with functional leaders to identify, define and deliver changes in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
The ideal candidate has exceptional technical, analytical, problem-solving and communication skills and is comfortable working with all levels of the organisation. You are self-directed and proactive, and you take the initiative to spot process improvements and see them through. You will gain a deep understanding of the GTM strategy and find new and creative ways to use Salesforce and its data to support more of the business, and you are motivated, team-oriented and passionate about Salesforce technology.
We will expect you to
Own the platform
• Own the configuration, design, functionality, data integrity and end-user support of our Salesforce platform.
• Own and manage the Salesforce roadmap, balancing new capability with day-to-day support and continuous improvement.
Architecture and design
• Design and maintain the architecture of our Salesforce org, including the data model, object relationships, automation strategy and integration patterns.
• Assess when business changes call for a change in structure or design, and lead that redesign so the platform scales and evolves with the business.
• Make build versus buy decisions, and evaluate new Salesforce features, AppExchange packages and connected tools.
• Document the system architecture, data model and key design decisions.
Build and configure
• Configure and maintain custom objects, record types, fields, page layouts, formulas, validation rules, Flows, approval processes and installed packages.
• Build new features in Sales Cloud and extend the platform with Flow Apex or Lightning Web Components where configuration is not enough.
Security, access and governance
• Maintain user roles and profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules and security settings.
• Establish and run change control and release management, including sandbox strategy, testing and deployment standards.
• Identify production risks and areas for improvement, then prioritise, design and lead the successful rollout and adoption of new processes.
Data and integrations
• Manage data imports, de-duplication and clean-up, and set the standards that keep our data accurate.
• Lead our implementation of Agentforce, shaping how AI agents in Salesforce support our sales and marketing teams, from identifying use cases through to configuration, rollout and adoption.
• Manage the integration of applications connected to Salesforce, including but not limited to Marketo, Bizible, Chorus, Intercom and Claude.
Stakeholders and enablement
• Engage with business stakeholders to gather and analyse requirements, propose solutions that use Salesforce functionality, and turn approved solutions into high-quality deliverables.
• Partner closely with our Marketing Operations Manager, and collaborate with Revenue Operations, Marketing and other business stakeholders, to drive data integrity and the reliability of our standardised analytics, tools and processes.
• Partner with our revenue leaders to gain an understanding of our renewals and sales process to enable Salesforce to optimally support these workflows. • Develop and deliver end-user training, and create and maintain all training materials and guides for Salesforce business processes.
Experience and skills we look for
• Extensive experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud.
• Expert in building and maintaining Salesforce solutions, with a track record of both delivering new features and running day-to-day support.
• Experience designing Salesforce architecture, including data models, automation and integrations, for a growing business.
• Strong understanding of data structures and data modelling.
• Hands-on experience with security models, permissions, change control and release management.
• Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification, or working towards it. Platform App Builder or Application Architect certification is a plus.
• Ability to identify areas for process improvement and recommend and implement solutions.
• Proven creativity and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and around obstacles.
• Ability to build effective relationships with business users, technical staff and executive management.
• Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Hands-on, flexible and service-minded, with a proven ability to embrace change.
• Experience with Apex and/or Lightning Web Components is a plus.
• Experience with Agentforce or other AI capabilities in Salesforce is a plus.
Benefits
 
At Kitman Labs we pride ourselves on being the best and working with the best, so it should be no surprise that we are also dedicated to keeping the best through building a world-class work culture.
We truly believe that a successful company begins through having an outstanding and inspiring culture, so our benefits reflect this:
- Competitive salary
- Health insurance for employee & dependants
- Meaningful equity
- Pension Plan
- Life Cover
- Income protection
- Wellbeing benefits
 
Location
 
While this role allows for remote work, occasional face-to-face-gatherings are recommended.
 
Diversity
 
In addition to building a team with diverse skill-sets, Kitman Labs is committed to hiring people with diverse backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on age, civil or family status, disability, ethnicity, gender, race, religion, or sexual orientation. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please let us know.
 
You can find information about how we process, share and keep your personal data safe by reading our privacy policy

Who are we
Knight Frank Finance operates as a specialist division of Knight Frank LLP, delivering bespoke property finance solutions to clients across the UK and international markets. Headquartered at Knight Frank’s Global HQ at 55 Baker Street, London, the business forms part of one of the world’s leading independent real estate consultancies, combining the strength of a global network with deep expertise in complex lending.
At the core of Knight Frank Finance is a commitment to providing more than traditional mortgage advice. The team offers a comprehensive range of property finance services, including large loan arrangements, equity release and highly tailored funding structures designed to meet the sophisticated needs of high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals. Through long-standing relationships with private banks and lenders, the business is recognised as a market leader in the large-loan and complex financing space.
Clients are central to everything Knight Frank Finance delivers. Built on trust, discretion and a deep understanding of individual circumstances, each relationship is approached with care and precision. By combining unrivalled market insight with decades of collective experience, the team is able to provide clear, strategic guidance across Prime Central London, the Home Counties and key international markets, consistently delivering exceptional, personalised outcomes.
Knight Frank Finance’s people are integral to its success. Bringing together a highly experienced and collaborative team, the business fosters an environment where expertise, innovation and client focus thrive. Working closely with colleagues across Knight Frank’s global network, the team contributes to a seamless, end-to-end client experience, ensuring access to exclusive opportunities and best-in-class advice.
Through its specialist knowledge, global reach and unwavering focus on client outcomes, Knight Frank Finance continues to set the standard in high-value property lending, supporting clients in achieving their property ambitions now and into the future. Learn more about what sets us apart here.
About The Role
Knight Frank are looking for a Finance Assistant to join our Finance team based at our Head Office in Baker Street.
The role supports the Finance Supervisor with daily income reconciliation and maintaining payment records in the CRM, while working closely with the administration and paraplanning teams.
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for managing the business’s day-to-day bank accounts, preparing invoices and payments for referrals and introducers, and supporting month-end delivery.
Responsibilities: Banking and Income Reconciliation
• Complete daily banking and ensure all transactions are recorded accurately.
• Reconcile client fees and lender procuration fees against the relevant CRM cases.
• Reconcile insurance commission payments and process any clawbacks.
• Prepare TMA statements and reconcile payments to the reported totals.
• Investigate and resolve income reconciliation discrepancies.
• Ensure banking records are complete and up to date for month-end.
Invoicing, Payments and Debt Management
• Raise invoices and payment requests and obtain the required approvals.
• Process referral payments through the Hub and ensure introducers are paid promptly.
• Monitor, report and pursue outstanding client fees.
• Report bad debts reflected in the management accounts.
Operational and Team Support
• Manage and respond to enquiries received through the Finance inbox.
• Work with administrators to resolve fee-related queries.
• Support the Finance Supervisor with external audits and month-end activities.
• Maintain accurate, complete and well-organised finance records and folders.
• Provide feedback on data quality and help address any identified issues.
Experience required:
Technical experience
• Experience in income reconciliation.
• Understanding of finance.
• Proficiency in Excel and financial reporting.
Planning and delivery
• Ability to plan ahead, work proactively and meet deadlines.
• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workload and provide direction when required.
• High levels of attention to detail and accuracy.
Communication and teamwork
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
• Experience of leading and developing a small team.
Competitive Salary

job_description:
Home About Kopin Careers Career Opportunities Embedded Software Engineer III – Dalgety Bay, Scotland POSITION: Embedded Software Engineer III – Dalgety Bay, Scotland
LOCATION: Dalgety Bay, Scotland, United Kingdom (On-site)
**The right to live and work in the UK is a must-have pre-requisite for this posting**
JOB PURPOSE:
The Embedded Software Engineer III contributes to the development and optimization of firmware and embedded software for Kopin’s microdisplay-based systems, including AR/VR HUDs, wearable display platforms, and related embedded products. This role requires strong proficiency in embedded systems, real-time software implementation, and hands-on experience with hardware/software integration on low-power embedded devices.
The role develops software for custom hardware platforms including ARM processors, microcontrollers, and FPGA-adjacent subsystems, and ensures robust, reliable operation across imaging, tracking, display-pipeline, control, and sensor-driven functions. This role works collaboratively across electrical, systems, optics, and mechanical engineering teams and participates throughout the full software development life cycle from design and implementation through testing, integration, and documentation.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: • Design, implement, and maintain firmware and low-level embedded software for portable, wearable, and low-power embedded devices.
• Develop device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, and board support package components for custom ARM- and MCU-based platforms.
• Implement and optimize embedded software for real-time operation on resource-constrained hardware, with consideration for performance, memory use, and power consumption.
• Implement and manage multithreading, interrupt handling, timers, DMA, and task scheduling in RTOS or bare-metal environments.
• Work closely with hardware engineers to define firmware-to-hardware interface requirements, timing expectations, sequencing, and configuration.
• Support integration of embedded software with FPGA-based or FPGA-adjacent subsystems where applicable, including register/control interfaces, data movement, timing coordination, and system debug.
• Troubleshoot and debug system-level issues involving display timing, sensor data alignment, peripheral communication, memory bandwidth, and hardware/software interactions.
• Apply best embedded software design practices to create modular, maintainable, and reusable code bases.
• Participate in full software lifecycle activities including design documentation, code reviews, unit tests, regression tests, and integration testing.
• Contribute to embedded applications, simple user interfaces, or engineering tools used for product configuration, validation, internal evaluation, or demonstrations.
• Collaborate with Systems Engineering to ensure embedded implementations satisfy system requirements, timing budgets, and performance margins.
• Maintain firmware architecture and ensure clarity, robustness, and long-term maintainability across code bases.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:
**The right to live and work in the UK is a must-have pre-requisite for this posting**
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline with a focus on embedded systems.
• 5-8 years of professional experience in embedded software development.
• Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems.
• Experience with RTOS or bare-metal development, including interrupt handlers, timers, DMA, context switching, and memory management.
• Demonstrated experience developing low-level drivers and hardware interfaces (SPI, I²C, UART, GPIO, timers, DMA, display or sensor interfaces).
• Familiarity with image processing or digital signal processing concepts.
• Hands-on experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD, and in-circuit debugging tools.
• Ability to contribute independently to embedded development while working within a cross-disciplinary engineering team.
PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:
• Master’s degree in EE/CE/CS or related field.
• Experience developing software for portable, wearable, or imaging/display-centric embedded systems.
• Experience working with FPGA-based systems, including firmware interaction with FPGA logic, register/control interfaces, timing-sensitive coordination, or board-level integration/debug.
• Experience with GUI frameworks (Qt, LVGL, embedded UIs) and integration with display pipelines.
• Python experience for scripting, automation, test tooling, or data analysis.
• Linux familiarity—including user space, device interfaces, kernel modules, or embedded distributions.
• Working knowledge of video and display interfaces (MIPI-DSI/CSI, LVDS, HDMI, DisplayPort, or custom microdisplay timing).
• Familiarity with image formats and compression (YUV/RGB, JPEG/PNG, H.264/H.265).
• Exposure to wireless communication protocols (BLE, Wi-Fi, or proprietary RF).
• Understanding of local file systems, storage interfaces, and data-persistence mechanisms on embedded devices.
• Strong modular software design and object-oriented development practices.
• Experience with revision control tools (Git preferred), including branching strategies and code review workflows.
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
• Able to rotate from sitting to standing, lift up to 20 pounds, and gown according to clean room protocol
GENERAL:
Hours of work: 39-hour week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (4:00pm on Friday) with 30 minutes for lunch; the company offers certain flexibility/change of the core working hours in line with the Flexible Working Policy, however; flexibility regarding working hours is also expected from the employee.
LOCATION:
The right to live and work in the UK is a pre-requisite for this position. The role is based in the Company’s facility in St. David’s Business Park, Dalgety Bay, Fife but flexibility around a combination of on and off-site working (work from home) is supported where practicable; a small amount of travel may be required.
BENEFITS PACKAGE:
30 days annual leave (plus 5 statutory days), competitive personal pension scheme with company contribution, life assurance scheme.
To apply please send your resume to: Jobs@Kopin.com

Home About Kopin Careers Career Opportunities Manufacturing Engineer – Dalgety Bay, Scotland POSITION: Manufacturing Engineer – Dalgety Bay, Scotland
LOCATION: Dalgety Bay, Scotland, United Kingdom (On-site)
REPORTING TO: Operations Manager
**The right to live and work in the UK is a must-have pre-requisite for this posting**
JOB PURPOSE:
We are seeking a motivated Manufacturing Engineer with 3+ years hands on experience in high level assembly and volume manufacturing in the technology industry. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, improving, and supporting manufacturing processes that ensure high-quality, cost-effective, and efficient production of products.
You will have the opportunity to contribute across multiple disciplines and play a key role in scaling production, introducing new products, and driving operational excellence.
The successful candidate will be a dynamic team player working within a small multi-functional group with common goals to cost effectively bring new products and technologies to customers under tight deadlines.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: • Develop, implement, and continuously improve manufacturing processes for new and existing products including scale up from prototype to volume manufacturing.
• Support the introduction of new products into manufacturing, including process development, documentation, and validation.
• Support the development and implementation of Micro OLED and MicroLED test systems within the Dalgety Bay facility.
• Provide day-to-day engineering support to production, resolving technical issues and minimising downtime.
• Support equipment selection, installation, commissioning, maintenance, and process validation.
• Analyse manufacturing workflows to identify opportunities for productivity improvements, cost reduction, and waste elimination.
• Create and maintain manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, process flows, SOPs, and Bills of Materials.
• Work closely with suppliers to resolve manufacturing and quality issues.
• Ensure manufacturing processes comply with company quality standards and health & safety requirements.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:
**The right to live and work in the UK is a must-have pre-requisite for this posting**
• Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 3+ years’ experience in a manufacturing engineering role within a high-tech, electronics, precision mechanical environment.
• Experience with process development, production support, and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Experience with root cause analysis and structured problem-solving methodologies.
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a small team.
• Strong analytical and organisational skills.
PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:
• Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.
• Familiarity with ISO quality management systems. ISO 9001, 13485, 14001
• Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC) and process validation.
• Experience with automation, robotics, or advanced manufacturing technologies.
• Experience working in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment.
• Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Inventor, Creo, or similar).
PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES:
• Hands-on and practical approach to engineering.
• Self-motivated with a proactive attitude.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
• Can display innovative thinking and creativity.
• Flexible and willing to take on a broad range of engineering responsibilities.
• Passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
GENERAL:
Hours of work: 39-hour week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (4:00pm on Friday) with 30 minutes for lunch; the company offers certain flexibility/change of the core working hours in line with the Flexible Working Policy, however; flexibility regarding working hours is also expected from the employee.
LOCATION:
The right to live and work in the UK is a pre-requisite for this position. The role is based on site in the Company’s facility in St. David’s Business Park, Dalgety Bay, Fife. Candidate must be within commutable distance to our Dalgety Bay, Fife location. A small amount of travel may be required.
BENEFITS PACKAGE:
30 days annual leave (plus 5 statutory days), competitive personal pension scheme with company contribution, life assurance scheme.
To apply please send your resume to: Jobs@Kopin.com

Annual leave
We encourage everyone to take time off to rest and recharge. You’ll get up to 30 days plus bank holidays. We also close over the festive period.
• 02
Work from anywhere
As well as your annual leave, you’ll also get twenty days to work remotely from anywhere else in the world.
• 03
Working from other Koto studios
You can apply to work from any of the other Koto studios for a fixed period of time.
• 04
Working from home
We believe we do our best work in person. But on Fridays feel free to work from home.
• 05
Becoming a parent
We offer enhanced paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave packages. Mothers get a years’ paid leave, where pay starts at 100% and is then staggered throughout the year. Fathers get up to eight weeks’ leave with full pay.
• 06
Health and wellbeing
You can access discounted gym membership at Third Space, save money on your bike through cyclescheme, and access wellbeing-related benefits via the Juno platform.
• 07
Annual bonus
All employees have the potential for a discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of their salary.
• 08
Years of service
After five years of service, you’ll get £5,000 and five extra days’ holiday. After ten years, you’ll get £10,000 and four weeks’ additional holiday.
• 09
Regular socials
We create opportunities to spend time together, not working. From free gallery and cinema trips to fitness, and plenty in between.
• 10
Global get-togethers
We operate as one big global team, so we make time to get everyone together in one place as often as possible.
• 11
Flexible hours
We work an eight hour day with core hours between 10-5pm. Outside of those hours, you can arrive a bit earlier or leave a bit later depending on your plans.
• 12
Personal progression
We hold biannual reviews to give 360 feedback and take the opportunity to celebrate a job well done, with salary reviews taking place at the end of each year. We also make sure you get regular, meaningful access to your manager to support your personal development and career growth.
• 13
Transparent salary brackets
We make available all salary bands and job descriptions to create fair and open opportunities for everyone.
• 14
Pension contributions
We contribute 3% to anyone wanting to engage in our pension scheme.
• 15
Continuous learning
We offer a range of different learning options through YCN, tailored to your needs. It includes hundreds of online and in-person courses. Plus we also organize regular learning lunches in the studio and attend talks together.
• 16
Food and drink
We provide free breakfast, snacks and drinks in our well-stocked kitchen.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Kpler's AI products are changing how commodity and maritime professionals access and interpret market intelligence. Through our AI surfaces, MCP server, which can be used within tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and enterprise copilots, and our AI Assistant embedded in the Kpler terminal, customers can ask questions in natural language and receive analysis grounded in Kpler data.
We are looking for a technically minded, customer-facing Sales Specialist – AI Products to support the adoption and growth of Kpler's AI offering globally. You will work closely with prospects and existing customers, demonstrating how our AI products can address their specific needs, integrate into their existing technology environments and deliver tangible commercial value.
Acting as the technical counterpart to our Commercial teams, you will lead customer demonstrations, design and deliver workshops, support integrations and help customers understand the capabilities, value and security of our AI products. You will also play an important role in shaping the AI product roadmap through direct customer feedback and market insights.
\n

Key Responsibilities
Deliver discovery-led, tailored demonstrations of Kpler's AI Assistant and MCP server to prospective and existing customers, engaging stakeholders from analysts through to C-level executives.
Design and deliver hands-on customer workshops, identifying relevant use cases, developing tailored prompts and workflows, and supporting ongoing adoption through customer enablement.
Develop reusable workshop formats, demonstration materials and prompt libraries to support consistent customer engagement and product adoption.
Own the technical narrative around Kpler's MCP server, clearly explaining tool calling, authentication, single sign-on (SSO), integrations, data scoping and permissions, including how customer data is accessed and protected.
Support customers with integrating Kpler's MCP into their existing technology environments, including Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, internal agents, notebooks and BI platforms.
Work closely with Account Executives and Customer Success teams to support customer evaluations, trials and proof-of-concept engagements, helping address technical questions and remove barriers to adoption.
Support commercial discussions around AI product packaging, pricing and value propositions, building compelling ROI cases and confidently addressing customer objections.
Gather and communicate structured customer feedback to the AI Product team, identifying product gaps, technical blockers, integration challenges and opportunities to influence the product roadmap.
Collaborate with Engineering, Product and Marketing teams to resolve technical challenges, develop customer-facing content and support AI product education across the business.
Contribute to pipeline development through account and stakeholder mapping, opportunity qualification, industry events and customer engagement.

Skills and Experience
5+ years' experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management or a technical analyst position with a strong commercial focus.
Hands-on experience with Large Language Model (LLM) products, including prompting, agentic workflows, tool calling and an understanding of model limitations and context management.
Strong API knowledge, including REST, authentication methods and rate limits, with the ability to read and troubleshoot technical documentation.
Comfortable using Python or notebooks to prototype demonstrations and explore technical use cases.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical audiences and senior business stakeholders.
Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to articulate product value, support pricing discussions and build compelling business cases and ROI propositions.
Experience supporting technical integrations and working with cross-functional teams, including Product and Engineering.
Excellent written and spoken English.
A proactive, curious and customer-focused approach, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical business value.

\n

We are seeking a motivated Configuration Management Engineer to support the delivery of Configuration Management (CM) and Data Management (DM) activities across engineering programmes throughout the product lifecycle.
This role is ideal for someone at the start of their engineering career who has strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and an interest in engineering processes and governance. You will work closely with engineering teams and experienced Configuration Management professionals, developing your knowledge of C&DM principles, processes and tools while helping to maintain the integrity of project data and technical baselines.
You will receive training and support to build your understanding of the five key Configuration Management disciplines: Planning, Identification, Change Control, Status Accounting, and Verification & Audit.
A few of our employee benefits are:
• Hybrid working where possible, three days onsite per week – upon successful completion of probationary period.
• Half day finish on a Friday
• 25 days holiday per year (plus bank holidays), increasing with long service and with the opportunity to buy/sell up to 5 days • Private medical insurance with optional family cover
• Pension scheme of up to 8% employer contribution
• Life Assurance 4x salary (flexible up to 10x) • Group income protection
• Flexible opt-in extras such as a health care cash plan, dental insurance, gym membership, critical illness cover, cycle to work scheme, travel insurance and electric car scheme
• Employee Family Assistance Program providing mental health and wellbeing support • Professional membership reimbursement (discretionary) What the role will involve
The responsibilities of your role will include the following:
• Assisting with the implementation of Configuration Management processes across engineering projects.
• Supporting the preparation, maintenance, and review of Configuration Management Plans and associated documentation.
• Maintaining configuration records, product structures, baselines, and project data within approved tools and repositories.
• Supporting engineering change processes by preparing documentation, tracking actions, and maintaining change records.
• Assisting with Configuration Status Accounting activities, including the collection, management, and reporting of configuration information.
• Supporting configuration verification and audit activities to ensure project documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable procedures.
• Working with engineering and programme teams to ensure technical data and deliverables are correctly identified, controlled, and released on time.
• Assisting with document control, issue management, and data distribution activities.
• Contributing to process improvement activities and supporting the adoption of Configuration Management best practice.
• Maintaining accurate records whilst working to agreed quality, schedule, and business requirements.
What you’ll bring The role requires the following experience and skills:
• Degree, HNC/HND, apprenticeship, or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Business Systems, Project Controls, or a related discipline.
• Basic understanding of Configuration Management principles and their application within an engineering environment.
• Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• A logical and methodical approach to problem solving.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, and other document control applications.
• Willingness to learn and develop knowledge of Configuration Management and engineering lifecycle processes.
Desirable
• Understanding of document control, quality management systems, or engineering governance processes.
• Familiarity with engineering, product lifecycle management (PLM), or document management tools.
• Familiarity with programming or scripting languages, such as Python, and an interest in using automation to improve engineering and configuration management processes. • Awareness of data analysis and reporting techniques using tools such as Python, Power BI, or Microsoft Excel.
• Understanding of version control concepts and tools (e.g. Git) would be advantageous.

Crown House Technologies | Enterprise Solutions

Are you an experienced BMS Commissioning Engineer looking to work on bigger, better projects?
Do you have a strong technical background in Building Management Systems, with experience commissioning complex building controls within data centres or other mission-critical environments?
Then our in-house MEP Engineering business, Crown House Technologies, is the company for you!
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced BMS Commissioning Engineer to join our Enterprise Solutions team, working on a major Data Centre project in Dagenham.
You'll play a key role in the commissioning, testing and integration of Building Management Systems, ensuring all systems operate efficiently, reliably and in accordance with project specifications and client requirements.
If you join us, you'll be a valued member of an industry-leading team, offering an exciting and varied career with access to some truly great projects.
What will the role look like?
- Carry out commissioning, testing and validation of Building Management Systems (BMS) across a large-scale data centre project.
- Undertake point-to-point testing, I/O checks, functional testing and system verification in accordance with approved commissioning procedures.
- Commission BMS controllers, field devices, sensors, actuators and associated control equipment.
- Review and validate control strategies, points schedules, schematics and technical specifications.
- Support the testing and integration of BMS with mechanical, electrical and other critical building systems.
- Identify, investigate and resolve software, hardware and communications issues during commissioning.
- Carry out functional performance testing to ensure systems operate in accordance with the specified sequence of operations.
- Support integrated systems testing (IST), witnessing activities and client demonstrations.
- Work closely with project managers, commissioning managers, specialist subcontractors and wider MEP teams to coordinate commissioning activities.
- Maintain accurate commissioning records, test documentation, progress reports and system handover information.
- Ensure all commissioning activities are completed safely, to the required quality standards and in line with project programmes.
What skills & experience are we looking for?
- Proven experience as a BMS Commissioning Engineer within commercial, industrial or mission-critical environments.
- Strong technical understanding of Building Management Systems, HVAC controls and building automation.
- Experience commissioning BMS controllers, field devices and associated control systems.
- Knowledge of BMS communication protocols, including BACnet and Modbus.
- Experience interpreting control panel drawings, wiring diagrams, points schedules and control strategies.
- Ability to undertake point-to-point testing, fault finding, functional testing and system validation.
- Understanding of BMS integration with mechanical and electrical building services.
- Experience working with BMS software, graphics, alarms, trends and system configuration.
- Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams.
- Relevant electrical, controls, automation or engineering qualifications, or equivalent industry experience.
- A proactive approach to health, safety and quality.
Previous experience commissioning BMS within data centres or other mission-critical facilities would be highly advantageous.

The Head of Clinical Trial Recruitment & Workforce at LGC serves as a strategic and operational lead within the NIHR Life Sciences Industry Hub. Collaborating with the Director of Operations, the role co-develops and drives the overall implementation plan to increase recruitment for commercial clinical trials across NHS R&D infrastructure.
The role serves as a consultant and operational link between the NIHR, NHS R&D networks, and the commercial life sciences sector. It manages recruitment processes to cover all essential support service agreements within the UK commercial portfolio.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to capably perform each of the following essential duties:
Strategic Leadership & System Consultation
• Workplan Development & Implementation: Collaborate closely with the Industry Hub Operations Director to develop and implement national recruitment improvement workstreams.
• Industry & R&D Interface: Function as a national authority and consultant linking NIHR R&D, NHS infrastructure, and commercial industry sponsors to increase recruitment reliability, tackle enrolment challenges, and reinforce sponsor trust in UK delivery.
• Collaborate with the Industry Hub Operations Director and key partners across NIHR Infrastructure and the wider research ecosystem to remove operational silos between study set-up and trial delivery.
• Ensure national workforce and recruitment strategies align with the NIHR Industry Hub Commercial Portfolio Lifecycle. These strategies must also match national research priorities to meet the 150-day timelines at all sites.
Performance, Data, and Quality Assurance
• Incentive Reform: Define tangible growth benchmarks and build models to improve year-on-year recruitment growth and screening consistency rather than conservative targeting.
• Tracking Milestones and Growth: Operationalise high-volume and specialised therapeutic areas to establish national and specialty-specific growth benchmarks.
• Performance Analysis: Identify patterns in recruitment performance, addressing post-FPFV drop-offs, zero-enrolling sites, and lower-recruiting study phases across NHS Trusts.
• Issue Resolution & Customer Concern: Serve as the national operational point for addressing complex recruitment blockages, site-level capacity constraints, or trial accrual failures related to customer concerns.
Workforce Capacity & Financial Reinvestment
• Capacity Release & Redesign: Identify workforce, service, and infrastructure constraints, introducing alternative and shared capacity models to release research capacity.
• Analyse research income recovery and distribution across Trusts. Develop and share core reinvestment principles with R&D departments. This ensures trial income directly strengthens clinical research workforce capacity.
• Extensive operational experience in driving clinical-trial recruitment, participant retention, and delivery to target within NHS research and development or a commercial sponsor environment.
• Experience navigating the UK clinical-trials lifecycle, including operational collaboration with the HRA, MHRA, and NIHR Research Delivery Network systems.
• Substantial experience in workforce-capacity planning, clinical-team resourcing, or managing R&D financial recovery/reinvestment structures within the NHS.
• Deep understanding of post-set-up trial-delivery challenges, recruitment-performance analytics, and clinical-research workforce dynamics across secondary, primary, and specialized care.
• Highly developed consultation and negotiation skills, with the proven ability to bridge commercial industry requirements and NHS system capacity.
• Proficiency in data-driven project management, including operational dashboards used to monitor recruitment velocity, identify underperforming sites, and mitigate delivery risks.
Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications:
• Experience leading large-scale operational change or scaling standardised pathways across multiple health boards or networks.
• Detailed knowledge of the regulatory landscape and technical-assurance requirements governing ATMPs, oncology, or multi-setting and decentralised clinical trials.

Role Overview
The Portal DevOps Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for supporting the delivery, reliability, and operational readiness of portal services. The role combines practical engineering across cloud platforms, identity and authentication services, CI/CD tooling, Linux, and networking with leadership responsibilities including backlog refinement, user story creation, work prioritisation, delivery management, release management, and production support handover to BAU teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Act in partnership with the Portal Team Owner to help define strategy, future growth and best of breed service.
• Lead backlog refinement activities, ensuring work items are clearly defined, prioritised, and ready for delivery.
• Create, shape, and refine user stories, acceptance criteria, technical tasks, and delivery dependencies.
• Prioritise engineering work in collaboration with product owners, delivery managers, architects, security teams, and operational stakeholders.
• Provide hands-on DevOps engineering support across AWS services, CI/CD pipelines, Linux environments, networking, and identity and authentication components.
• Manage delivery plans, track progress, identify risks and blockers, and support predictable delivery against agreed milestones.
• Own and coordinate release management activities, including release planning, environment readiness, deployment coordination, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication.
• Ensure production support handover to BAU teams is complete, including operational documentation, support processes, monitoring expectations, known issues, and escalation paths.
• Support incident investigation, problem management, and service improvement activities where DevOps expertise is required.
• Promote automation, repeatability, security, resilience, and operational excellence across the portal platform.
• Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and leadership to engineers while remaining actively involved in implementation and troubleshooting.
Required Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of identity management concepts, access control, authentication, authorisation, and secure user lifecycle management.
• Experience with authentication flows and federation standards, including SAML and OIDC.
• Hands-on experience with AWS services, including EC2, EKS, CloudFront, RDS, and AWS Transfer Family.
• Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.
• Strong Linux administration, shell usage, troubleshooting, and operational support skills.
• Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, certificates, TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting.
• Experience supporting cloud-hosted production services, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational readiness.
• Ability to translate technical requirements into deliverable engineering tasks and support implementation through to release.
Leadership and Delivery Expectations
• Act as the technical delivery lead for portal DevOps workstreams, balancing hands-on contribution with coordination and leadership.
• Drive clarity across scope, dependencies, acceptance criteria, sequencing, and release readiness.
• Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear updates on progress, risks, issues, and decisions required.
• Support team planning ceremonies and ensure work is broken down into achievable, well-understood deliverables.
• Champion production readiness, secure delivery practices, documentation quality, and effective transition into BAU support.
• Lead by example through practical engineering contribution, pragmatic decision-making, and a focus on reliable service outcomes.
Experience and Background
The successful candidate will typically have significant experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, with demonstrable experience delivering and supporting production-grade services. They should be comfortable working across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and BAU operational teams, and should be able to move confidently between strategic planning, delivery coordination, and hands-on technical problem solving.
Key Success Measures
• Backlog items are clear, prioritised, and ready for delivery.
• User stories and technical tasks are well-defined with appropriate acceptance criteria.
• Releases are planned, communicated, delivered, and supported effectively.
• Production support handovers are complete, practical, and accepted by BAU teams.
• Portal platform changes are delivered securely, reliably, and with appropriate operational documentation.
• Technical risks, dependencies, and blockers are identified early and managed proactively.

About Lunio
Lunio is building a performance marketing platform that helps businesses reduce wasted spend and improve ROI. Our customers are household brands at the cutting edge of digital advertising. Our products directly influence customer performance, retention and growth. We operate with high autonomy, high accountability, and measurable commercial expectations. This team will be working across Data-Science and our Full Stack Engineering team in our Measurement and Data product pillar.
The role
You will own Lunio’s measurement and data platform, including attribution, identity, pipelines and integrations. You will turn complex marketing data into reliable measurement and commercially valuable products. You will be given high autonomy and accountability for business outcomes. You love working in an environment where you can move from ambiguity to a shipped outcome quickly, and test before you build.
What you will be responsible for
Own the measurement and data product strategy and roadmap. Make build, buy and deprecate decisions that balance customer and commercial value, reuse across customers, and ongoing operating cost.
Own the integrations roadmap across advertising platforms, data warehouses, CDPs and CRMs, including partner relationships and API dependencies.
Lead continuous discovery with customers, commercial teams, engineers and designers. Keep customers involved early and test the highest-risk assumptions quickly.
Have worked directly with engineering teams, demonstrating you can build trust across commercial, engineering and design, bringing people with you without formal authority
Write clear, rigorous specifications (PRDs, acceptance criteria, data and integration requirements) that give engineers clarity on what to build.
Own data-quality and reliability outcomes with engineering: agree customer-facing targets, prioritise improvements by customer and commercial impact, and track results.
What we are looking for
Must have:
Strong understanding of digital advertising, performance marketing and conversion measurement. You understand how platforms such as Google Ads and Meta capture, optimise, attribute and report conversions, and how conversion data flows.
Strong understanding of identity, matching and modern marketing data stacks, including first-party identifiers, identity stitching, CDPs, CRMs and data warehouses.
You understand the limits of attribution, when incrementality testing is needed, and how data quality, identity and privacy constrain what can be claimed. You can judge when excluding traffic or audiences cuts waste and when it costs more opportunity than it saves.
You have owned a data-intensive product or platform capability from customer discovery through production use. You can explain the product decisions and technical trade-offs you owned, the measurable outcomes, and where evidence changed your direction.
You can independently read API documentation, interrogate sample data and trace conversion flows. You work directly with engineers on data models, matching logic and failure cases, challenging options and making informed product trade-offs.
Nice to haves:
You have owned a platform, API or integrations product in high-growth B2B SaaS with commercial accountability.
You have worked directly with major advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok or Microsoft Ads, including their APIs and data models.
You prototype with AI tools to test ideas quickly before work enters a sprint.
What success looks like
In your first 6 months, we would expect to see:
An evidence-backed roadmap with clear priorities, success measures and explicit decisions about what not to build.
Shipped capabilities are in production use, with measured impact on an agreed customer or platform outcome and evidence of their commercial contribution.
Data quality and pipeline reliability are measured, reported and improving against a baseline you set.

Enterprise Product Manager
The Role
Lyrebird is already trusted by thousands of clinicians, and the largest health organisations in Australia and the UK are now rolling it out across their entire workforce. This is a new role, created to lead the next chapter of our enterprise product as those deployments grow in size and ambition. You'll own the enterprise product end to end: the core platform capability that serves every enterprise customer, and the tailored work that deepens our partnership with specific ones. You'll have a real roadmap, a real engineering team, and the scope to shape where enterprise goes next.
A good week in this role might include a roadmap session with a state health service's IT team, a deep dive with a private hospital group to understand what's behind their latest request and how it could become something every enterprise customer benefits from, and a morning with engineering working out which of three competing priorities goes first. Your customers are the people deploying Lyrebird across their organisation, not the clinicians themselves, so you'll spend more time in customer conversations than most PMs do. If you enjoy that mix, and like being the person who makes the call when everything seems urgent, you'll do well here.
About Us
We turn real clinical conversations into accurate notes, automatically, backed by ambient real time document creation, intelligent document management and clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a patient and clinical communications layer. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We're growing fast across Melbourne, the UK, and Asia, and there's a finite window right now to set the standard for clinical AI in Australia before anyone else does.
What you'll do
Own the enterprise product, extending how Lyrebird serves hospitals, health services and multi-site groups: org hierarchy, SSO and provisioning, admin tooling, template governance, audit and usage reporting
Shape the enterprise roadmap, sequencing the platform capability that unlocks our next wave of large-scale deployments, and use it as a tool to communicate direction to customers, setting clear expectations about what's coming and when.
Build and own the prioritisation framework for enterprise, with clear, written criteria for core and tailored work that the whole business can rely on
Bring several independent streams of enterprise requests into one set of priorities, so every request has a clear home, a priority and a rationale anyone can explain
Turn tailored customer requests into buildable solutions, and spot the ones that are really core product needs wearing a customer's name
Stand up the voice-of-customer loop, spending real time with senior customer stakeholders and making sure what they tell you shapes what gets built
Drive roadmap decisions from usage and adoption data, working hand in hand with our UK team so every market benefits from what we learn
Deliver customer-specific integrations and workflows for some of the largest health organisations in the country, coordinating across engineering teams you don't own
What you'll bring
Experience owning a B2B or enterprise product end to end, shipped for large, complex organisations with their own governance, stakeholders and procurement
A track record of handling bespoke customer work without refusing it outright or letting it consume the roadmap, and the real examples to show how you made those calls
A habit of prioritising with written, defensible criteria, and the ability to walk through the trade-offs behind decisions you've made
Credibility in the room with senior enterprise customers: presenting and defending a roadmap to an executive or IT lead, and knowing when to hold the line and when to change course
The technical fluency to work credibly with engineers on architecture, integration and feasibility, and to land dependencies with teams that have their own roadmaps
Nice to have
Experience in health tech, clinical software or another regulated domain, including familiarity with EMRs and Australian health system structures such as LHDs, HHSs and private hospital groups
Hands-on experience building enterprise platform capability (SSO, provisioning, permissions, audit) or integration depth with HL7, FHIR and identity
An understanding of what hospital security, privacy and information-governance reviews demand of a vendor
Experience working across two markets with different regulatory requirements, or standing up a voice-of-customer loop from scratch
When a hospital rolls Lyrebird out to every clinician on every ward, the product has to work for the organisation as well as for the doctor in the room. The enterprise product is how thousands more clinicians spend their time on patients instead of paperwork, in the places where the pressure, and the risk of something being missed, is highest. That's the work.

If you're from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement.

JOB SUMMARY

The Power BI / Data Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day data
management, reporting and business intelligence activities supporting the EMEA
Finance organization. The role serves as the primary owner of critical data
processes underpinning the month-end close, forecast, business planning and
annual budget cycles across the entire EMEA portfolio.

The position is responsible for managing the end-to-end loading, validation,
reconciliation and governance of financial and operational data supporting more
than one thousand hotels across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The role
ensures the integrity, accuracy and timeliness of data used by continent
leadership, regional teams, hotels and MIHQ stakeholders.

In addition, the role leads the development and enhancement of Power BI
reporting solutions, supports the migration to modern data platforms including
Microsoft Fabric, and drives continuous improvement through automation,
standardization and innovation.

SCOPE

The Power BI / Data Manager provides data management, reporting, business
intelligence, governance and user support across EMEA Finance, with specific
ownership of key data processes supporting month-end close, forecast, business
planning and budget cycles.

Financial Cycle Data Management

 * Own and lead all month-end, forecast, business planning and budget cycle data
   loads across the EMEA portfolio.
 * Manage data collection, validation, transformation and loading processes into
   reporting platforms.
 * Ensure timely and accurate delivery of reporting data supporting key finance
   deadlines.
 * Identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues in partnership with
   regional and hotel finance teams.

Reporting & Analytics

 * Lead development and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reporting
   solutions supporting EMEA Finance Operations.
 * Drive reporting standardization and enhancement opportunities across the
   continent.
 * Deliver actionable insights and analytics to support decision making.
 * Support migration and development activities within Microsoft Fabric and the
   broader Microsoft data ecosystem.

Data Governance & Controls

 * Implement robust controls ensuring completeness, accuracy and consistency of
   financial information.
 * Establish data standards, documentation and governance processes.
 * Maintain strong auditability and transparency across reporting datasets.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

 * Identify opportunities to automate manual finance and reporting processes.
 * Leverage Power Platform, Power Query, SQL and related technologies to improve
   efficiency.
 * Support innovation initiatives that enhance reporting effectiveness and
   reduce manual effort.

Stakeholder Management

 * Partner with continent, regional and hotel finance teams throughout all
   financial cycles.
 * Act as the primary point of contact for planning and reporting data
   requirements.
 * Provide training and support to reporting users and key stakeholders.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

 * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business
   or related discipline.
 * Minimum 4-6 years of experience in business intelligence, finance reporting,
   data management or analytics.
 * Demonstrated experience supporting planning, forecasting and reporting
   processes.
 * Advanced Power BI experience required.
 * Experience with financial systems, data warehousing and reporting platforms
   preferred.
 * Hospitality, finance operations or multinational company experience
   preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes

 * Advanced Power BI development skills including DAX, Power Query and data
   modelling.
 * Strong Excel expertise and experience managing large datasets.
 * Experience with SQL and database management.
 * Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform and modern reporting
   technologies.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
 * Strong project management, planning and organizational skills.
 * Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities within a fast-paced
   finance environment.

EXPECTED CONTRIBUTIONS

 * Deliver all data loads accurately and on time for month-end close, forecast,
   business planning and budget cycles.
 * Ensure high levels of data integrity and reporting reliability.
 * Improve efficiency through automation and process enhancement.
 * Support strategic reporting and analytical requirements across EMEA Finance
   Operations.
 * Develop scalable reporting solutions that improve business visibility and
   decision making.
 * Foster strong partnerships with stakeholders across the continent.
 * Continuously enhance the reporting environment and data management processes.

MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES

Leadership

 * Communication; Professional demeanor; accountability; ability to influence
   stakeholders through expertise.

Managing Execution

 * Driving for results; Planning and organizing; project coordination; deadline
   management; issue resolution.

Building Relationships

 * Customer relationships; coworker relationships; stakeholder management;
   collaboration with hotels, regional teams, continent teams and MIHQ.

Generating Talent and Organizational Capability

 * Provides training and support to reporting users and key stakeholders; builds
   data and reporting capability through documentation and user guidance.

Learning and Applying Professional Expertise

 * Power BI; DAX; Power Query; data modelling; Excel; SQL; Microsoft Fabric;
   data governance; finance reporting and planning processes.

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

 * Power BI Development: ability to build, maintain and enhance dashboards,
   semantic models and reporting solutions supporting EMEA Finance Operations.
 * Financial Cycle Data Management: ability to manage data loading, validation,
   transformation and reconciliation for month-end, forecast, business planning

Additional Responsibilities

Job Description:
Job Purpose/Overview
We require a highly skilled and experienced professional to independently lead and drive the Corporate R&D Process and Systems team’s digitalization efforts. This role is critical to advancing a global, cross-segment R&D digital transformation program, enhancing efficiency, speed, and future-proofing our business.
The role will report directly into the Digital Core Q&FS/R&D pillar and will extend its scope to include Quality & Food Safety (Q&FS) and other R&D Edge capabilities-related activities. The successful candidate will take ownership of the data and process related activities in relation to Enterprise Digital Core capabilities, including Quality Management (Testing & Conformance, Inbound and Outbound Traceability), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and seamless integration with Product Portfolio Management (PPM). These Enterprise R&D Digital capabilities will be deployed in all Royal Canin business units through the EOS program.
This position requires a strategic thinker and a technical leader who will collaborate with senior stakeholders across RC and Enterprise to ensure data integrity, compliance, and alignment with Mars’ business objectives.
The Corporate R&D/Q&FS Digital Core Data Champion is responsible for supporting the operational work related to activities managing R&D Master Data modeling, data requirement gathering and integration design. Collaborate with the Digital Core Data Manager to create and execute the data migration (ETL) strategy and the operational data governance efforts across R&D Edge, Core Quality (S4 & MDG), PPM and R&D Analytics. This role will be involved in the development and implementation of data models and integration processes to ensure data integrity, consistency, and quality across all business functions and compliant with regulations.
This role will be a crucial part of the process mapping efforts in Signavio, developing and maintaining detailed process maps for all R&D Edge and Q&FS activities, including material master data management, product lifecycle management, and quality control workflows.
This role is expected to work in partnership with the DT Data modelling solution architect, the Corporate R&D Material Master Data Champions, the Corp R&D Digital Core Senior leaders (Quality, Cplm, Process, SRA, Supply, SQA), the Segment Systems representatives and SMEs and the Functional Experts.
This role is transformation funded and has an expected length of around 3 years.
What will be your key responsibilities?
STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather functional data requirements, in order to develop and implement a comprehensive data modeling blueprint
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather functional process requirements, in order to develop a detailed business process map in Signavio
• Help to create stakeholder updates such as newsletters, roadmap updates
• Help facilitate the connection with Sustainability, Regulatory Affairs, Trade Compliance, Commercial etc .
R&D MASTER DATA MODELING
• Lead the creation and evolution of a data modeling blueprint that incorporates best practices and innovative solutions
• Define and enforce data modeling standards, policies, and procedures to ensure consistency and quality across the R&D data ecosystem.
• Establish and oversee data governance practices for master data, including data stewardship, data quality, and metadata management.
• Stay at the forefront of data modeling techniques and technologies and drive the adoption of innovative solutions to enhance the R&D data infrastructure.
• Continuously evaluate and refine data models to improve data accuracy, accessibility, and utility for analytics and reporting.
DATA REQUIREMENT GATHERING, DATA MIGRATION (ETL) STRATEGY AND TOOLSET
• Lead activities and procedures such as capturing data definitions and data owners on the Data Wiki.
• Leading segment data harmonization activities in Veritas to support Digital Core
• Support operational data quality work in R&D across Q&FS, ERP and other capabilities
• Support requirement gathering and translation from SRA, SQA, Quality, Product and Pack Developper, Supply, Sustainability, Finance, to ensure data compliance with regulatory and sustainability principles
• Support cross-functional data related decisions and collaborate in data related design and governance
• Create analysis to ensure accurate specifications for materials to be purchased, including raw materials, semi-finished goods, and finished products, especially related to the necessary data consolidation in RC
PROCESS MAPPING FOR Q&FS AND R&D
• Help to develop and maintain detailed process maps for all R&D Edge and Q&FS processes and analytics, including material master data management, product lifecycle management, and quality control workflows. • Ensure process maps are aligned with Mars’ global standards and regulatory requirements.
CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & DEPLOYMENT
• Create and maintain user-friendly documentation and training materials to facilitate the adoption of new data models and data assessment and data migration processes
• Document data definitions and attributes in a central repository (Mars wiki).
• Create and maintain regular or one-off Data Quality and/or Data Validation analysis.
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging the team to seek out and implement process enhancements.
• Drive innovation by exploring new tools, methodologies, and approaches to enhance the data modelling process, data cleansing, data migration, data quality.
What are we looking for?
• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to collect and translate business needs into technical requirements.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Fluent in English.
• The ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
• Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership.
• Being able to work independently and take initiative – strong ability to work in a virtual environment across multiple time zones and cultures.
What can you expect from Mars?
• Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
• Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
• A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
• An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Job Description:
Job Title: Document Controller Location: London Head Office – Hybrid
Role Purpose
Manage project documents for assigned UK renewable energy and construction projects. Ensure documents are correctly numbered, recorded, submitted, tracked and shared in line with company and client requirements.
Work with Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Management, Quality, HSE, Planning and Commissioning departments and their document controllers. Ensure project teams and subcontractors receive the latest approved documents and that complete records are available for project handover.
Key Responsibilities
1. Document Management
- Set up and maintain project folders, document registers, drawing registers and submission trackers.
- Check document numbers, titles, revisions, naming formats and approval status before submission or distribution.
- Record incoming and outgoing documents and keep registers updated.
- Maintain a clear history of submissions, comments, approvals and resubmissions.
- Ensure documents are easy to find and stored in the correct project folders.
- Follow the document control requirements agreed for each project and client.
2. Document Management Systems
- Use electronic document management systems such as Doc Point, Aconex, New Prodom, SharePoint and similar platforms.
- Upload, register, update, search for and distribute documents using company and client systems.
- Manage document review workflows, transmittals and submission records.
- Check that document details and revisions are consistent across different systems.
- Monitor outstanding reviews and follow up with the responsible teams.
- Support folder setup, user access and system workflows within the permissions provided.
- Support document transfers between digital quality tools and client systems when required.
3. Coordination with All Departments
- Coordinate with all relevant departments and their document controllers to collect documents and keep submissions on schedule.
- Communicate client document requirements, submission deadlines and review comments to the responsible teams.
- Follow up on missing documents, outstanding comments and overdue resubmissions.
- Work with Engineering and Procurement document controllers to receive current drawings, documents and approval updates.
- Follow agreed submission responsibilities to avoid duplicate uploads and conflicting records.
- Refer technical questions and comments to the responsible department. Technical preparation, checking and approval remain with the relevant document owners.
4. Client Submissions and Review Tracking
- Check that documents are ready for submission and submit them through the agreed client system.
- Prepare transmittals and keep evidence of each submission.
- Track documents awaiting submission, under review, approved, approved with comments, rejected and resubmitted.
- Keep previous review outcomes visible when documents are resubmitted.
- Share client comments with the responsible departments and follow up until responses are provided.
- Identify reasons for returned or rejected submissions and coordinate corrections.
- Highlight overdue documents and review delays to the relevant project leads.
5. Distribution to Site Teams and Subcontractors
- Share the latest approved drawings, specifications, procedures and other required documents with site teams and subcontractors.
- Check document revisions and whether they are approved for the intended use before issuing them.
- Maintain records showing what was issued, when and to whom.
- Obtain receipt acknowledgements where required.
- Notify teams and subcontractors when documents are revised or replaced.
- Support the removal of outdated documents from active use.
- Raise missing approvals, conflicting revisions or document errors with the responsible team.
6. Project Reports and Meetings
- Prepare weekly and monthly document status reports.
- Maintain dashboards showing outstanding submissions, overdue reviews, rejected documents and missing information.
- Collect and format construction, quality and other project reports using information provided by the responsible departments.
- Ensure report content is checked by the responsible department before issue.
- Prepare meeting minutes and track agreed actions when required.
- Support project teams with document control guidance and system use.
7. Audits and Project Handover
- Provide document records and submission evidence for internal and client audits.
- Coordinate the collection of approved drawings, inspection records, certificates, commissioning documents and operation and maintenance manuals.
- Compile completion and handover folders in line with client requirements.
- Maintain the handover document index and follow up on missing records.
- Ensure final project records are complete, organised and easy to retrieve.
Qualifications and Experience
- Degree or diploma in Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration or a related subject, or equivalent relevant work experience.
- At least five years of document control experience in construction, EPC, renewable energy, infrastructure, power or industrial projects.
- Experience managing documents across several projects and working with different departments, clients and subcontractors.
- Experience handling document submissions, review comments, revisions, approvals and final handover records.
- Practical experience using one or more of Doc Point, Aconex or New Prodom. Experience with several of these systems would be an advantage.
- Experience using SharePoint or similar document management systems.
- Good understanding of document numbering, naming rules, revision control and review workflows.
Skills and Personal Qualities
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, registers and trackers.
- Good working knowledge of Word, PowerPoint and Adobe Acrobat.
- Strong organisation skills and attention to detail.
- Clear written and verbal communication.
- Ability to follow up with different teams and meet deadlines.
- Ability to manage large numbers of documents across several projects.
- Careful handling of confidential information and user access.
- Willingness to learn new client systems and document requirements.
- Power BI knowledge and document control or EDMS certifications would be an advantage.
Expected Results
- Accurate and updated document registers.
- Timely submissions and follow-up of outstanding reviews.
- Clear records of comments, approvals and resubmissions.
- Latest approved documents available to site teams and subcontractors.
- Fewer submissions returned because of document control errors.
- Complete and organised project handover records.

Success in this role requires strong cross functional collaboration, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Foster teamwork, collaboration across geographies, and an inclusive workplace culture.

• 15+ years of industry experience in wireless technology design and/or architecture roles.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven expertise in microarchitecture, microcontroller development, and wireless product implementation.
• Strong knowledge of BLE, UWB, and Wi-Fi communication principles and standards.

To design the Women’s Ready-to-Wear (RTW) collections, working under the direction of the Design Director and contributing to the development of creative, commercially relevant and distinctive collections that reflect the Mulberry aesthetic. The Senior RTW Designer will take ownership of design projects from initial research and concept development through to sampling, fittings and PPS.

Research
